chapters.title: The current Polygon market
chapters.caption: This is the current interface reading the deployed Polygon market. No wallet is connected and no transaction is sent.

chapters.title: Follow the money through the three parties
chapters.caption: The animated diagram separates backing escrow, pool trading and the final payout.

chapters.title: Explore coverage without a transaction
chapters.caption: The renter calculator sizes the band: $60,000 annual rent corresponds to 3,000 RENT. Its cost estimate is a model.

chapters.title: Understand price and available liquidity
chapters.caption: Buy & Sell shows the current RENT price. A spot-price conversion is different from what the current pool can execute.

chapters.title: See the Uniswap integration
chapters.caption: The dedicated guide separates backing escrow, trading inventory, the timing hook and final redemption.

chapters.title: Read the price-implied rent level
chapters.caption: Market view converts price into a payout-equivalent growth level. It does not turn a capped token price into expected rent growth.

chapters.title: Verify the actual publisher email
chapters.caption: The actual CRE Daily publisher signature authenticates the $92.88/SF baseline. Its 2026 timestamp cannot settle the 2027 market.
